product_one_liner.value: Levitate helps relationship-based businesses nurture clients, prospects, and referral sources through personalized email, texting, social media, and other relationship-marketing tools.

pricing_page.notes: A public plans page exists; pricing is obtained by contacting sales.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents marketing, business-growth, industry, and product-update content by marketing staff, rather than a qualifying engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public help center links to multiple product articles and categories, including AI assistants, texting, campaigns, and integrations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The five listed openings comprise three SDR roles, an account-executive management role, and a Revenue Insights Coordinator role; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Levitate says it builds with Claude and names Google LLC among its underlying model providers.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims specify SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA-enabled functionality, and PCI DSS SAQ A; these are not all equivalent forms of certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced March 5, 2026. The company reported $16 million; PitchBook identifies the round as Series E and records $15.9 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The March 5, 2026 funding announcement falls within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sales Development Representative opening in Raleigh, North Carolina.

launched_6mo.notes: A September 25, 2026 announcement describes newly rolled-out AI features.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Casey Brady is listed as Senior Vice President of Sales, and his profile dates his current Levitate experience to April 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Publicly documented integration signal, not confirmation that Salesforce is Levitate's internal CRM.
